# Isaiah Chapter 28 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 29 verses]*

*Proud crown of drunkards; cornerstone in Zion; covenant with death; line upon line; farmer parable*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 28 (Woe to Ephraim) addresses proud crown of drunkards; cornerstone in zion; covenant with death; line upon line; farmer parable. The key verse — "Behold, I am the one who has laid as a foundation in Zion a stone, a tested stone" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
